fr: Mereda keeps a lamp lit later than any of us. I have wondered what she reads by it.
es: Mereda keeps a lamp lit later than any of us. I have wondered what she reads by it.
it: Mereda keeps a lamp lit later than any of us. I have wondered what she reads by it.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تترك ميريدا مصباحا مشتعلا لفترة أطول من أي منا. لقد تساءلتُ عما تقرأه على ضوئه.

source_en: Mereda was conscripted. The Faith was generous with the word.
fr: Mereda was conscripted. The Faith was generous with the word.
es: Mereda was conscripted. The Faith was generous with the word.
it: Mereda was conscripted. The Faith was generous with the word.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تم تجنيد ميريدا. كان الإيمان سخيا بالكلمة.

source_en: My candles burn longer this season.
fr: Mes bougies durent plus longtemps cette saison.
es: Mis velas arden más tiempo esta temporada.
it: Le mie candele bruciano più a lungo in questa stagione.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: شموعي تحترق لفترة أطول هذا الموسم.

source_en: My candles burn longer this season. Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
fr: My candles burn longer this season. Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
es: My candles burn longer this season. Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
it: My candles burn longer this season. Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: شموعي تحترق لفترة أطول هذا الموسم. في بعضها، ينفد الفتيل قبل الشمع.

source_en: My hand has been cold since.
es: Mi mano ha estado fría desde entonces.
it: Da allora ho la mano fredda.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: No one rang the second peal.
fr: Personne n'a fait retentir le carillon la deuxième fois.
it: Nessuno ha suonato il secondo rintocco.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Not from anything that was done.
fr: Ce n'était pas dû à un acte quelconque.
es: No por nada de lo que se haya hecho.
it: Non per qualcosa che è stato fatto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: Ni à quoi que ce soit que nous connaissons.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Older than he can be. We do not ask.
fr: Plus âgé qu'il ne peut l'être. Nous ne posons pas de questions.
es: Más viejo de lo que puede ser. No preguntamos.
it: Più vecchio di quanto possa essere. Non chiediamo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: Une pierre a fait l'objet d'une dîme.
es: Se ha pagado el diezmo de una piedra.
it: Una pietra è stata offerta in decima.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: One stone has been tithed. There were three. I have not slept since they told me three.
fr: One stone has been tithed. There were three. I have not slept since they told me three.
es: One stone has been tithed. There were three. I have not slept since they told me three.
it: One stone has been tithed. There were three. I have not slept since they told me three.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: حجرٌ واحدٌ قد قُدِّم كعشور. كان هناك ثلاثة. لم أذق طعم النوم منذ أخبروني بأنها ثلاثة.

source_en: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city.
fr: Notre seigneur saigne sur la ville maudite.
es: Nuestro señor sangra sobre la ciudad maldita.
it: Nostro signore sanguina sulla città maledetta.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city. A dire omen to be sure!
fr: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city. A dire omen to be sure!
es: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city. A dire omen to be sure!
it: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city. A dire omen to be sure!
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: سيدنا ينزف فوق المدينة الملعونة. إنه نذير شؤم مؤكد!

fr: Merci de ne pas mettre le bazar.
es: Por favor, no hagas un desorden.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Pray as if Lunarin can hear you.
fr: Prie comme si Lunarin pouvait t'entendre.
es: Reza como si Lunarin pudiera oírte.
it: Prega come se Lunarin potesse sentirti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Pray as if Lunarin can hear you. Speak as if your brother can.
fr: Pray as if Lunarin can hear you. Speak as if your brother can.
es: Pray as if Lunarin can hear you. Speak as if your brother can.
it: Pray as if Lunarin can hear you. Speak as if your brother can.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: صلِّ كأن لوناران يسمعك. تحدث كأن أخاك يسمعك.

source_en: So that we may transcend the Dragon's Fire and resist the Coil...
fr: Afin que nous puissions transcender le feu du dragon et résister à la Spirale...
es: Para que podamos trascender el Fuego del Dragón y resistir la Espiral...
it: così che possiamo trascendere il fuoco del drago e resistere alla Spirale...
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لكي نتسامى فوق نار التنين ونقاوم اللفافة…

fr: C'est ce que l’on nous enseigne.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long,
fr: Certains ont commencé à demander pourquoi leur tour tardait tant à venir
es: Algunos han comenzado a preguntar en voz alta por qué su turno está tardando tanto,
it: Alcuni hanno iniziato a lamentarsi sul perché il loro turno non arrivi mai,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: بدأ البعض يتساءلون بصوت عال عن سبب تأخر دورهم،

source_en: Some of the brothers are gossips.
es: Algunos de los hermanos son chismosos.
it: Alcuni dei fratelli sono dei pettegoli.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: بعض الإخوة يميلون إلى القيل والقال.

source_en: Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun
fr: Certains frères affirment que le commandeur commence
es: Algunos de los hermanos dicen que el Comandante ha comenzado
it: Alcuni dei fratelli dicono che il comandante ha iniziato
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقول بعض الإخوة إن القائد بدأ يتحدث عنك كقريب،

source_en: Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun to speak of you as kin, Nephilim. Some of the brothers are gossips.
fr: Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun to speak of you as kin, Nephilim. Some of the brothers are gossips.
es: Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun to speak of you as kin, Nephilim. Some of the brothers are gossips.
it: Some of the brothers say the Commander has begun to speak of you as kin, Nephilim. Some of the brothers are gossips.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقول بعض الإخوة إن القائد بدأ يتحدث عنك كقريب، أيها النيفيليم. بعض الإخوة يميلون إلى القيل والقال.

source_en: Some of them, the wick gives out before the wax.
fr: Pour certaines, la mèche s'épuise avant la cire.
es: En algunas de ellas, la mecha se apaga antes que la cera.
it: In alcuni casi, lo stoppino si consuma prima della cera.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: في بعضها، ينفد الفتيل قبل الشمع.

source_en: Something walked past the door that night.
fr: Cette nuit-là, quelque chose est passé devant la porte.
es: Algo pasó junto a la puerta esa noche.
it: Quella notte qualcosa è passato davanti alla porta.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: شيء ما مرّ بجانب الباب في تلك الليلة.

source_en: Something walked past the door that night. I did not look. I have not opened that door since.
fr: Something walked past the door that night. I did not look. I have not opened that door since.
es: Something walked past the door that night. I did not look. I have not opened that door since.
it: Something walked past the door that night. I did not look. I have not opened that door since.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: شيء ما مرّ بجانب الباب في تلك الليلة. لم أنظر. ولم أفتح ذلك الباب منذ ذلك الحين.

source_en: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left.
fr: Il arrive parfois que le chevalier soit encore dans la pièce alors qu’il est déjà parti.
es: A veces el Caballero aún está en la habitación después de que el Caballero se ha ido.
it: A volte il cavaliere è ancora nella stanza anche dopo che se n'è andato.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أحيانا يظل الفارس في الغرفة بعد أن يغادر الفارس.

source_en: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left. The brothers do not speak of this.
fr: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left. The brothers do not speak of this.
es: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left. The brothers do not speak of this.
it: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left. The brothers do not speak of this.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أحيانا يظل الفارس في الغرفة بعد أن يغادر الفارس. الإخوة لا يتحدثون عن هذا.

source_en: Speak as if your brother can.
fr: Parle comme si ton frère en était capable.
es: Habla como si tu hermano pudiera.
it: Parla come se potesse farlo tuo fratello.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Stronger again. I had not believed stronger was something one could see across a hall.
fr: Stronger again. I had not believed stronger was something one could see across a hall.
es: Stronger again. I had not believed stronger was something one could see across a hall.
it: Stronger again. I had not believed stronger was something one could see across a hall.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أقوى من جديد. لم أكن أؤمن أن "الأقوى" شيء يمكن رؤيته عبر القاعة.

source_en: That Spire gnaws at Eden's veil. Divine protect us.
fr: Cette flèche ronge le voile d'Éden. Que le Divin nous protège.
es: Esa Aguja roe el velo del Edén. Que el Divino nos proteja.
it: Quella Torre corrode il velo dell'Eden. Che il Divino ci protegga.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ذلك البرج ينهش حجاب إيدن. فليحمنا الإله.

fr: Les anges sont les enfants de Lunarin.
es: Los Ángeles son hijos de Lunarin.
it: Gli angeli sono i figli di Lunarin.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Angels are Lunarin's children. But WE are Lunarin's hands.
fr: The Angels are Lunarin's children. But WE are Lunarin's hands.
es: The Angels are Lunarin's children. But WE are Lunarin's hands.
it: The Angels are Lunarin's children. But WE are Lunarin's hands.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الملائكة هم أبناء لوناران. لكننا نحن أيدي لوناران.

source_en: The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound.
fr: Le commandeur a donné des conseils. Ces conseils étaient judicieux.
es: El Comandante dio consejo. El consejo fue sólido.
it: Il comandante ha dato un consiglio. Il consiglio era sensato.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Commander has been in this Order
fr: Le commandeur fait partie de cet Ordre
es: El Comandante ha estado en esta Orden
it: Il comandante fa parte di quest'Ordine
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Commander has been in this Order for one hundred and twenty-six years. We have done the arithmetic.
fr: The Commander has been in this Order for one hundred and twenty-six years. We have done the arithmetic.
es: The Commander has been in this Order for one hundred and twenty-six years. We have done the arithmetic.
it: The Commander has been in this Order for one hundred and twenty-six years. We have done the arithmetic.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: قضى القائد في هذه الجماعة مئة وستة وعشرين عاما. لقد أجرينا الحسابات.

source_en: The Commander is old. Older than he looks.
fr: Le commandeur est âgé. Plus âgé qu'il n'en a l'air.
es: El Comandante es viejo. Más viejo de lo que parece.
it: Il comandante è vecchio. Più vecchio di quanto sembri.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: القائدُ عجوز. أكبر مما يبدو عليه. أكبر مما يمكن أن يكون.

source_en: The Commander is old. Older than he looks. Older than he can be. We do not ask.
fr: The Commander is old. Older than he looks. Older than he can be. We do not ask.
es: The Commander is old. Older than he looks. Older than he can be. We do not ask.
it: The Commander is old. Older than he looks. Older than he can be. We do not ask.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: القائدُ عجوز. أكبر مما يبدو عليه. أكبر مما يمكن أن يكون. نحن لا نسأل.

source_en: The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday.
fr: Dimanche dernier, le commandeur s'est agenouillé dans la chapelle.
es: El Comandante se arrodilló en la capilla el domingo pasado.
it: Il comandante si è inginocchiato nella cappella domenica scorsa.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: جثا القائد في المصلى الأحد الماضي.

source_en: The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday. He knelt for an hour, though he did not pray.
fr: The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday. He knelt for an hour, though he did not pray.
es: The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday. He knelt for an hour, though he did not pray.
it: The Commander knelt in chapel last Sunday. He knelt for an hour, though he did not pray.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: جثا القائد في المصلى الأحد الماضي. جثا لساعة كاملة، رغم أنه لم يصلِّ.

source_en: The Commander treats the Knight as family.
fr: Ce dernier le considère comme un membre de sa famille.
es: El Comandante trata al Caballero como familia.
it: Il comandante tratta il cavaliere come un membro della famiglia.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يعامل القائد الفارس كفرد من عائلته.

source_en: The Dry Rot King is freed.
fr: Le Roi de la pourriture brune a été libéré.
es: El Rey de la Podredumbre Seco ha sido liberado.
it: Il Re della Putrefazione è stato liberato.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Dry Rot King is freed. Freed to where, I am not told. I fear to ask.
fr: The Dry Rot King is freed. Freed to where, I am not told. I fear to ask.
es: The Dry Rot King is freed. Freed to where, I am not told. I fear to ask.
it: The Dry Rot King is freed. Freed to where, I am not told. I fear to ask.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لقد أُطلق سراح ملك العفن الجاف. لم يُخبرني إلى أين أُطلق سراحه. أخشى أن أسأل.

source_en: The Faith does not permit absence.
es: La Fe no permite la ausencia.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Faith has had its small mercy,
fr: La Foi a eu droit à un peu de clémence,
es: La Fe ha tenido su pequeña misericordia,
it: La Fede ha avuto la sua piccola misericordia,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: La Foi a retrouvé le silence.
it: La Fede ha il suo silenzio.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Faith holds its peace with the Order.
fr: La Foi maintient la paix avec l'Ordre.
es: La Fe mantiene la paz con la Orden.
it: La Fede mantiene la pace con l'Ordine.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Faith holds the rite is for the dying.
fr: Selon la Foi, ce rite est destiné aux mourants.
es: La Fe sostiene que el rito es para los moribundos.
it: La Fede sostiene che il rito sia destinato ai morenti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Faith holds, Nephilim, that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
fr: The Faith holds, Nephilim, that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
es: The Faith holds, Nephilim, that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
it: The Faith holds, Nephilim, that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تؤكد العقيدة، يا نيفيليم، أن كل ما يُكدّس سيتفكك في نهاية المطاف.

source_en: The Faith is the State, and the State is the Faith. The man who serves one does not betray the other.
fr: The Faith is the State, and the State is the Faith. The man who serves one does not betray the other.
es: The Faith is the State, and the State is the Faith. The man who serves one does not betray the other.
it: The Faith is the State, and the State is the Faith. The man who serves one does not betray the other.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الإيمان هو الدولة، والدولة هي الإيمان. من يخدم أحدهما لا يخون الآخر.

source_en: The Faith is to be praised,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الإيمان يستحق الثناء، لقد عاد الفارس.

source_en: The Faith is to be praised, the Knight has returned. I have praised the Faith. I have praised, also, the Knight.
fr: The Faith is to be praised, the Knight has returned. I have praised the Faith. I have praised, also, the Knight.
es: The Faith is to be praised, the Knight has returned. I have praised the Faith. I have praised, also, the Knight.
it: The Faith is to be praised, the Knight has returned. I have praised the Faith. I have praised, also, the Knight.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الإيمان يستحق الثناء، لقد عاد الفارس. لقد ثنيتُ على الإيمان. لقد ثنيتُ، أيضا، على الفارس.

source_en: The Faith permits silence. The Faith does not permit absence. Find the line between.
fr: The Faith permits silence. The Faith does not permit absence. Find the line between.
es: The Faith permits silence. The Faith does not permit absence. Find the line between.
it: The Faith permits silence. The Faith does not permit absence. Find the line between.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الإيمان يسمح بالصمت. الإيمان لا يسمح بالغياب. جِد الخط الفاصل بينهما.

source_en: The Faith was generous with the word.
fr: La Foi ne manquait pas de mots.
es: La Fe fue generosa con la palabra.
it: La Fede era generosa con la parola.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: La Foi n'a pas été consultée.
es: No se consultó a la Fe.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Knight asked the Commander for counsel
fr: Le chevalier a demandé conseil au commandeur
es: El Caballero pidió consejo al Comandante
it: Il cavaliere ha chiesto consiglio al comandante
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: طلب الفارس المشورة من القائد ثلاث مرات هذا الأسبوع.

source_en: The Knight asked the Commander for counsel three times this week. The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound. I find I am not surprised by this.
fr: The Knight asked the Commander for counsel three times this week. The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound. I find I am not surprised by this.
es: The Knight asked the Commander for counsel three times this week. The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound. I find I am not surprised by this.
it: The Knight asked the Commander for counsel three times this week. The Commander gave counsel. The counsel was sound. I find I am not surprised by this.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: طلب الفارس المشورة من القائد ثلاث مرات هذا الأسبوع. أعطى القائد المشورة. كانت المشورة سديدة. أجد أنني لست متفاجئا بهذا.

source_en: The Knight buys from the Merchant often.
fr: Le chevalier fait souvent des achats chez le marchand.
es: El Caballero le compra al Comerciante a menudo.
it: Il cavaliere compra spesso dal mercante.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Knight buys from the Merchant often. I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
fr: The Knight buys from the Merchant often. I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
es: The Knight buys from the Merchant often. I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
it: The Knight buys from the Merchant often. I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يشتري الفارس من التاجر كثيرا. أعرف ما يُشترى. لا أعرف ما يُدفع.

source_en: The Knight is back. The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
fr: The Knight is back. The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
es: The Knight is back. The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
it: The Knight is back. The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الفارس عاد. رُنّت الأجراس. سمعتُ الأجراس.

source_en: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week.
fr: Le Knight pèse plus lourd sur la pierre que la semaine dernière.
es: El Knight se apoya más sobre la piedra que la semana pasada.
it: Il cavaliere è più pesante rispetto alla settimana scorsa.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الفارس أثقل وزنا على الحجر مما كان عليه الأسبوع الماضي.

source_en: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week. The stones know.
fr: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week. The stones know.
es: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week. The stones know.
it: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week. The stones know.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الفارس أثقل وزنا على الحجر مما كان عليه الأسبوع الماضي. الحجارة تعلم.

source_en: The Knight is much in the Commander's company.
fr: Le chevalier passe beaucoup de temps avec le commandeur.
es: El Caballero pasa mucho tiempo en compañía del Comandante.
it: Il cavaliere è spesso in compagnia del comandante.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقضي الفارس وقتا طويلا في رفقة القائد.

source_en: The Knight is much in the Commander's company. The Commander treats the Knight as family.
fr: The Knight is much in the Commander's company. The Commander treats the Knight as family.
es: The Knight is much in the Commander's company. The Commander treats the Knight as family.
it: The Knight is much in the Commander's company. The Commander treats the Knight as family.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقضي الفارس وقتا طويلا في رفقة القائد. يعامل القائد الفارس كفرد من عائلته.

fr: Le chevalier est rentré sain et sauf.
es: El Caballero regresó sano y salvo.
it: Il cavaliere è tornato sano e salvo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Knight returned safely. I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
fr: The Knight returned safely. I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
es: The Knight returned safely. I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
it: The Knight returned safely. I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: عاد الفارس بسلام. لقد بدأتُ في عدّ المرات التي عاد فيها الفارس… متغيرا.

source_en: The Knight visits the Librarian often.
fr: Le chevalier va souvent voir la bibliothécaire.
es: El Caballero visita a la Bibliotecaria a menudo.
it: Il cavaliere fa spesso visita alla bibliotecaria.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Knight visits the Librarian often. I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
fr: The Knight visits the Librarian often. I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
es: The Knight visits the Librarian often. I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
it: The Knight visits the Librarian often. I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يزور الفارس أمينة المكتبة كثيرا. قيل لنا إن هذا من شؤون الجماعة وليس من شؤون الإيمان.

source_en: The Merchant has no surname in the register.
fr: Le nom de famille du marchand n'apparaît pas dans le registre.
es: El Comerciante no tiene apellido en el registro.
it: Il mercante non ha un cognome registrato.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: التاجر ليس له اسم عائلة في السجل.

source_en: The Merchant has no surname in the register. I am bothered by that.
fr: The Merchant has no surname in the register. I am bothered by that.
es: The Merchant has no surname in the register. I am bothered by that.
it: The Merchant has no surname in the register. I am bothered by that.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: التاجر ليس له اسم عائلة في السجل. هذا الأمر يزعجني.

source_en: The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see.
fr: Le marchand est difficile à regarder. Il n'est pas difficile à voir.
es: El Comerciante es difícil de mirar. No es difícil de ver.
it: Il mercante è difficile da guardare, ma non da vedere.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: التاجر يصعب النظر إليه. لكنه ليس صعب الرؤية.

source_en: The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see. We have been taught the difference.
fr: The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see. We have been taught the difference.
es: The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see. We have been taught the difference.
it: The Merchant is hard to look at. He is not hard to see. We have been taught the difference.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: التاجر يصعب النظر إليه. لكنه ليس صعب الرؤية. لقد عُلِّمنا الفرق.

source_en: The Merchant pays for his keep in souls.
fr: Le marchand paie son séjour en âmes.
es: El Comerciante paga por su manutención con almas.
it: Il mercante paga il suo mantenimento in anime.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Merchant pays for his keep in souls. We are told this is metaphor. We are told this is metaphor.
fr: The Merchant pays for his keep in souls. We are told this is metaphor. We are told this is metaphor.
es: The Merchant pays for his keep in souls. We are told this is metaphor. We are told this is metaphor.
it: The Merchant pays for his keep in souls. We are told this is metaphor. We are told this is metaphor.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يدفع التاجر ثمن بقائه بالأرواح. قيل لنا إن هذا مجاز. قيل لنا إن هذا مجاز.

source_en: The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company.
fr: Le Nephilim et la bibliothécaire passent beaucoup de temps ensemble.
es: El Nefilim y la Bibliotecaria pasan mucho tiempo juntos.
it: I Nefilim e la bibliotecaria stanno spesso in compagnia l'uno dell'altro.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: النيفيليم وأمينة المكتبة كثيرا ما يرتادان بعضهما.

source_en: The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company. Two who do not pray conspiring together.
fr: The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company. Two who do not pray conspiring together.
es: The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company. Two who do not pray conspiring together.
it: The Nephilim and Librarian are much in each other's company. Two who do not pray conspiring together.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: النيفيليم وأمينة المكتبة كثيرا ما يرتادان بعضهما. اثنان لا يصليان يتآمران معاً.

source_en: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room...
fr: Le Nephilim est arrivé ce matin, et la pièce...
es: El Nefilim llegó esta mañana, y la habitación...
it: Il Nefilim è entrato stamattina, e la stanza...
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room... settled. I have not the word.
fr: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room... settled. I have not the word.
es: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room... settled. I have not the word.
it: The Nephilim came in this morning, and the room... settled. I have not the word.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: وصل النيفيليم هذا الصباح، والغرفة… هدأت. لا أجد الكلمة.

source_en: The Nephilim was not at evening prayer.
fr: Le Nephilim n'était pas à la prière du soir.
es: El Nefilim no estuvo en la oración de la tarde.
it: Il Nefilim non era presente alla preghiera serale.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Nephilim was, at that hour, abroad.
fr: À cette heure-là, le Nephilim était sorti.
es: El Nefilim estaba, a esa hora, afuera.
it: A quell'ora, il Nefilim era in giro.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Sanctus is colder for it.
fr: Il fait d'autant plus froid dans le Sanctus.
es: El Sacro es más frío por eso.
it: E per questo il Sanctus è più freddo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday.
fr: La Flèche n'est plus aussi penchée qu'hier.
es: La Aguja no se inclina como se inclinó ayer.
it: La Torre non pende più come ieri.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: البرج لا يميل كما مال بالأمس.

source_en: The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday. I am told I am imagining it.
fr: The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday. I am told I am imagining it.
es: The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday. I am told I am imagining it.
it: The Spire does not lean as it leant yesterday. I am told I am imagining it.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: البرج لا يميل كما مال بالأمس. قيل لي إنني أتخيل ذلك.

source_en: The War Table is rarely free of you and the
fr: Ces temps-ci, le commandeur et toi êtes souvent
es: La Mesa de Guerra rara vez está libre de ti y del
it: Il tavolo di guerra è raramente non occupato da te
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نادرا ما تخلو طاولة الحرب منك ومن القائد هذه الأيام،

source_en: The War Table is rarely free of you and the Commander these days, Nephilim. The other Knights wait their turn. Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long, and I am running out of comfortable answers.
fr: The War Table is rarely free of you and the Commander these days, Nephilim. The other Knights wait their turn. Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long, and I am running out of comfortable answers.
es: The War Table is rarely free of you and the Commander these days, Nephilim. The other Knights wait their turn. Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long, and I am running out of comfortable answers.
it: The War Table is rarely free of you and the Commander these days, Nephilim. The other Knights wait their turn. Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long, and I am running out of comfortable answers.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نادرا ما تخلو طاولة الحرب منك ومن القائد هذه الأيام، يا نيفيليم. الفرسان الآخرون ينتظرون دورهم. بدأ البعض يتساءلون بصوت عال عن سبب تأخر دورهم، وبدأت إجاباتي المريحة تنفد.

source_en: The barrier is thin. The Sanctus is colder for it. I had not believed it could be colder.
fr: The barrier is thin. The Sanctus is colder for it. I had not believed it could be colder.
es: The barrier is thin. The Sanctus is colder for it. I had not believed it could be colder.
it: The barrier is thin. The Sanctus is colder for it. I had not believed it could be colder.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الحاجز واهن. السانكتوس أكثر برودة بسبب ذلك. لم أكن أؤمن أنه يمكن أن يكون أكثر برودة.

fr: Le reflet dans le bassin est plus ancien.
es: El reflejo de la pileta es más antiguo.
it: Il riflesso del bacino è più antico.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The bells rang for the Knight's return.
fr: Les cloches ont sonné pour saluer le retour du chevalier.
es: Las campanas sonaron por el regreso del Caballero.
it: Le campane hanno suonato per il ritorno del cavaliere.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The bells rang for the Knight's return. They rang once more after. No one rang the second peal.
fr: The bells rang for the Knight's return. They rang once more after. No one rang the second peal.
es: The bells rang for the Knight's return. They rang once more after. No one rang the second peal.
it: The bells rang for the Knight's return. They rang once more after. No one rang the second peal.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: رنّت الأجراس لعودة الفارس. رنّت مرة أخرى بعد ذلك. لم يقرع أحدُ الرنة الثانية.

source_en: The bells were rung. I heard the bells.
fr: Les cloches ont sonné. Je les ai entendues.
es: Se tocaron las campanas. Escuché las campanas.
it: Le campane hanno suonato. Le ho sentite.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The blood moon. Divine have mercy, is this the end?
fr: La lune de sang. Ô divinités, ayez pitié. Est-ce la fin ?
es: La luna de sangre. Divino, ten piedad, ¿es este el final?
it: La luna di sangue. Divino abbia pietà di noi, è questa la fine?
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: قمر الدم. يا إلهي، ارحمنا، أهذه هي النهاية؟

source_en: The brothers do not speak of this.
es: Los hermanos no hablan de esto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The brothers do not speak of this.
es: Los hermanos no hablan de esto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The brothers will not enter that wing.
fr: Les frères refusent d’entrer dans cette aile.
es: Los hermanos no entrarán en esa ala.
it: I fratelli non entreranno in quell'ala.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now.
fr: Les bougies s'éteignent désormais lorsque le chevalier passe dans le couloir sud.
es: Ahora, cuando el Caballero pasa por el pasillo sur, las velas se atenúan.
it: Ora le candele si affievoliscono quando il cavaliere percorre il corridoio sud.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تخفت الشموع حين يمر الفارس عبر الممر الجنوبي الآن.

source_en: The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now. They did not used to.
fr: The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now. They did not used to.
es: The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now. They did not used to.
it: The candles dim when the Knight passes the south corridor now. They did not used to.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تخفت الشموع حين يمر الفارس عبر الممر الجنوبي الآن. لم يكن الأمر كذلك في السابق.

source_en: The dragon. I had not, in my life, expected there would be a dragon.
fr: The dragon. I had not, in my life, expected there would be a dragon.
es: The dragon. I had not, in my life, expected there would be a dragon.
it: The dragon. I had not, in my life, expected there would be a dragon.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: التنين. لم أكن، طوال حياتي، أتوقع وجود تنين.

source_en: The first Dead God is undone.
fr: Le premier dieu mort a été vaincu.
es: El primer Dios Muerto ha sido destruido.
it: La prima Divinità Defunta è stata annientata.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The first Dead God is undone. The Faith has had its small mercy, though it does not feel small.
fr: The first Dead God is undone. The Faith has had its small mercy, though it does not feel small.
es: The first Dead God is undone. The Faith has had its small mercy, though it does not feel small.
it: The first Dead God is undone. The Faith has had its small mercy, though it does not feel small.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الإله الميت الأول قد هُزم. لقد نال الإيمان رحمةً صغيرة، وإن لم تبدُ صغيرةً.

source_en: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins.
fr: Le bénitier était vide à l’heure des vêpres et plein à celle des matines.
es: La fuente estaba seca a la hora de las vísperas y llena a la hora de las maitines.
it: Il fonte battesimale era asciutto ai vespri e pieno al mattutino.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: كان الجرن جافا عند صلاة المساء وممتلئا عند صلاة الفجر.

source_en: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins. I did not refill it.
fr: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins. I did not refill it.
es: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins. I did not refill it.
it: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins. I did not refill it.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: كان الجرن جافا عند صلاة المساء وممتلئا عند صلاة الفجر. لم أقم بملئه.

source_en: The fourth day I was to rest.
fr: Le quatrième jour, je devais me reposer.
it: Il quarto giorno avrei dovuto riposare.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: وفي اليوم الرابع كان عليّ أن أرتاح.

source_en: The full dark is for things that have nothing left to hide.
fr: L'obscurité totale est réservée à ce qui n'a plus rien à cacher.
es: La oscuridad total es para aquellas cosas que ya no tienen nada que ocultar.
it: L'oscurità totale è per le cose che non hanno più nulla da nascondere.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الظلام الدامس هو للأشياء التي لم يعد لديها ما تخفيه.

es: Los mestizos toman la comunión por separado.
it: I mezzosangue prendono la comunione separatamente.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The half-bloods take communion separately. I am told this is for our comfort.
fr: The half-bloods take communion separately. I am told this is for our comfort.
es: The half-bloods take communion separately. I am told this is for our comfort.
it: The half-bloods take communion separately. I am told this is for our comfort.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يتناول الهُجَناء القربان بشكل منفصل. قيل لي إن هذا من أجل راحتنا.

source_en: The library where he taught smells of him still.
fr: La bibliothèque où il enseignait porte encore son odeur.
es: La biblioteca donde él enseñó aún huele a él.
it: La biblioteca in cui insegnava ha ancora il suo profumo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لا تزال رائحته تفوح في المكتبة حيث كان يدرس.

source_en: The man who serves one does not betray the other.
fr: Celui qui est au service de l'un ne trahit pas l'autre.
es: El hombre que sirve a uno no traiciona al otro.
it: Chi serve l'uno non tradisce l'altro.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: من يخدم أحدهما لا يخون الآخر.

source_en: The name will not appear in the register.
fr: Ce nom n'apparaîtra pas dans le registre.
es: El nombre no aparecerá en el registro.
it: Il nome non comparirà nel registro.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: هذا الاسم لن يظهر في السجل.

source_en: The other Knights wait their turn.
fr: Les autres chevaliers attendent leur tour.
es: Los otros Caballeros esperan su turno.
it: Gli altri cavalieri aspettano il loro turno.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith
fr: Le rite de conscription a été invoqué pour le forgeron
es: Se aplicó el rito del reclutamiento al herrero
it: Il rito della coscrizione fu invocato per il fabbro
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: استدعى قائد الفرسان طقس التجنيد على الحداد.

source_en: The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith by the Knight Commander. The Faith holds the rite is for the dying. The smith is, technically, dying. He has been dying for some years.
fr: The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith by the Knight Commander. The Faith holds the rite is for the dying. The smith is, technically, dying. He has been dying for some years.
es: The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith by the Knight Commander. The Faith holds the rite is for the dying. The smith is, technically, dying. He has been dying for some years.
it: The rite of conscription was invoked on the smith by the Knight Commander. The Faith holds the rite is for the dying. The smith is, technically, dying. He has been dying for some years.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: استدعى قائد الفرسان طقس التجنيد على الحداد. تؤمن العقيدة بأن الطقس مخصص للمحتضرين. والحداد، من الناحية التقنية، يحتضر. لقد ظل يحتضر لسنوات.

source_en: The second stone is here. I have lit a candle for the Knight. I have lit a candle for myself.
fr: The second stone is here. I have lit a candle for the Knight. I have lit a candle for myself.
es: The second stone is here. I have lit a candle for the Knight. I have lit a candle for myself.
it: The second stone is here. I have lit a candle for the Knight. I have lit a candle for myself.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الحجر الثاني هنا. لقد أشعلتُ شمعةً من أجل الفارس. لقد أشعلتُ شمعةً من أجلي.

source_en: The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed.
fr: Le péché que j'ai confessé ce matin est un péché que je n'ai pas encore commis.
es: El pecado que confesé esta mañana es uno que aún no he cometido.
it: Il peccato che ho confessato stamattina è uno che non ho ancora commesso.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الخطيئة التي اعترفتُ بها هذا الصباح هي خطيئة لم أرتكبها بعد.

source_en: The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed. The Faith encourages this.
fr: The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed. The Faith encourages this.
es: The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed. The Faith encourages this.
it: The sin I confessed this morning is one I have not yet committed. The Faith encourages this.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الخطيئة التي اعترفتُ بها هذا الصباح هي خطيئة لم أرتكبها بعد. الإيمان يشجع على ذلك.

source_en: The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
fr: Le forgeron fait toujours du bruit. Il aime le bruit.
es: El herrero siempre es ruidoso. Al herrero le gusta el ruido.
it: Il fabbro è sempre rumoroso. Al fabbro piace il rumore.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الحداد صاخب دائما. الحداد يحبّ الضجيج.

source_en: The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
fr: Il est doué dans son métier. Pour un loup.
es: El herrero es bueno en su trabajo. Para un lobo.
it: Il fabbro è bravo nel suo lavoro. Per essere un lupo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الحداد بارع في عمله. بالنسبة لذئب.

fr: Le forgeron fait beaucoup de bruit.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The smith is loud. The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
fr: The smith is loud. The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
es: The smith is loud. The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
it: The smith is loud. The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: الحداد صاخب. الحداد صاخب دائما. الحداد يحبّ الضجيج.

source_en: The smith toasted you with his wine last evening, Nephilim.
fr: Hier soir, le forgeron a trinqué à ta santé avec son vin, Nephilim.
es: El herrero brindó por ti con su vino anoche, Nefilim.
it: Ieri sera il fabbro ha brindato a te con il suo vino, Nefilim.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نخبك الحداد بنبيذه في الأمس، يا نيفيليم.

source_en: The smith was awake. The forge was cold.
fr: Le forgeron était réveillé. La forge était froide.
es: El herrero estaba despierto. La forja estaba fría.
it: Il fabbro era sveglio. La fucina era fredda.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: Les pierres leur souhaitent la bienvenue.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The two things must be held together.
fr: Ces deux aspects doivent être considérés ensemble.
es: Las dos cosas deben mantenerse juntas.
it: Le due cose devono essere tenute insieme.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ويجب أن يظل هذان الأمران متلازمين.

source_en: The visor was cut deep for a reason.
fr: Si sa visière les cache, c’est pour une bonne raison.
es: El visor está muy recortado por una razón.
it: La visiera era profonda per un motivo preciso.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لقد نُحت القناع بعمق لسببٍ ما.

fr: Cette voix ne se tait pas.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The work has not been done before.
fr: Le travail n'a encore jamais été fait.
es: El trabajo no se había hecho antes.
it: Questo lavoro non è mai stato completato prima.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

it: Il lavoro non è ancora finito.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: The work is not done. The work has not been done before. The work will be done.
fr: The work is not done. The work has not been done before. The work will be done.
es: The work is not done. The work has not been done before. The work will be done.
it: The work is not done. The work has not been done before. The work will be done.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: العمل لم ينتهِ. العمل لم يُنجز من قبل. العمل سينجز.

it: Il lavoro sarà portato a termine.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Their losses do not go in the public register.
fr: Leurs pertes ne figurent pas dans le registre public.
es: Sus pérdidas no van en el registro público.
it: Le loro perdite non vanno nel registro pubblico.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: خسائرهم لا تُسجل في السجل العام.

source_en: Their losses do not go in the public register. They go in another book. I have not been shown the other book.
fr: Their losses do not go in the public register. They go in another book. I have not been shown the other book.
es: Their losses do not go in the public register. They go in another book. I have not been shown the other book.
it: Their losses do not go in the public register. They go in another book. I have not been shown the other book.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: خسائرهم لا تُسجل في السجل العام. إنها تُسجل في كتاب آخر. لم يُطلعني أحد على ذلك الكتاب.

source_en: There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name.
fr: Il y a sept nuits dans le calendrier qui n'ont pas de nom.
es: Hay siete noches en el calendario que no tienen nombre.
it: Ci sono sette notti nel calendario che non hanno un nome.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: هناك سبع ليالٍ في التقويم ليس لها اسم. ومع ذلك،

source_en: There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name. We count them anyway.
fr: There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name. We count them anyway.
es: There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name. We count them anyway.
it: There are seven nights in the calendar that have no name. We count them anyway.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: هناك سبع ليالٍ في التقويم ليس لها اسم. ومع ذلك، نحن نعدّها.

source_en: There has not been a stag in this city in living memory.
fr: Nul n’a aperçu de cerf dans cette ville depuis des temps immémoriaux.
es: No ha habido un ciervo en esta ciudad en la memoria viva.
it: Non si è mai visto un cervo in questa città a memoria d'uomo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لم يظهر أيل في هذه المدينة منذ ذاكرة الأحياء.

source_en: There is a reading of this that flatters you,
fr: On peut interpréter cela de deux façons : l’une te flatte,
es: Hay una interpretación de esto que te halaga,
it: Da un certo punto di vista, la cosa dovrebbe lusingarti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أيها النيفيليم. هناك قراءة لهذا الأمر تداعب غرورك،

source_en: There is new steel where the old steel was.
fr: Il y a de l'acier neuf à la place de l'ancien.
es: Hay acero nuevo donde estaba el acero viejo.
it: Al posto del vecchio acciaio, c'è acciaio nuovo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: هناك فولاذٌ جديد حيث كان الفولاذُ القديم.

source_en: There is new steel where the old steel was. I had not noticed there was old steel.
fr: There is new steel where the old steel was. I had not noticed there was old steel.
es: There is new steel where the old steel was. I had not noticed there was old steel.
it: There is new steel where the old steel was. I had not noticed there was old steel.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: هناك فولاذٌ جديد حيث كان الفولاذُ القديم. لم ألحظ من قبل وجود فولاذٍ قديم.

fr: Ils sont en train d’être tricotés,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: They are knitted now, somewhere in the lower chambers. We do not ask how.
fr: They are knitted now, somewhere in the lower chambers. We do not ask how.
es: They are knitted now, somewhere in the lower chambers. We do not ask how.
it: They are knitted now, somewhere in the lower chambers. We do not ask how.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لقد غُزلت الآن، في مكان ما في الغرف السفلية. نحن لا نسأل كيف.

fr: Ils sont revenus sains et saufs.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: They came back whole. They did not look whole. Though I do not know the difference.
fr: They came back whole. They did not look whole. Though I do not know the difference.
es: They came back whole. They did not look whole. Though I do not know the difference.
it: They came back whole. They did not look whole. Though I do not know the difference.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: عادوا كاملين. لم يبدوا كاملين. ومع ذلك، لا أعرف الفرق.

fr: Ils n'avaient pourtant pas l'air de l’être.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: Avant, ce n'était pas le cas.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لم يكن الأمر كذلك في السابق.

source_en: They do not say what was sanctioned.
fr: La nature de la sanction reste à déterminer.
es: No dicen en qué consistió la sanción.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ولا يقولون ما هو العقاب الذي نالها.

fr: Elles sont consignées dans un autre livre.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: Elles ont ensuite sonné à nouveau.
it: Poi hanno suonato un'altra volta ancora.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum.
fr: On dit que la bibliothécaire a été sanctionnée lors du Quorum.
es: Dicen que la Bibliotecaria fue sancionada en Quorum.
it: Si dice che la bibliotecaria sia stata sanzionata dal Quorum.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقولون إن أمينة المكتبة قد عوقبت في "كوروم".

source_en: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum. They do not say what was sanctioned.
fr: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum. They do not say what was sanctioned.
es: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum. They do not say what was sanctioned.
it: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum. They do not say what was sanctioned.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقولون إن أمينة المكتبة قد عوقبت في "كوروم". ولا يقولون ما هو العقاب الذي نالها.

source_en: They went out. They did not return whole.
fr: Ils sont partis. Ils ne sont pas revenus entiers.
es: Salieron. No regresaron sanos y salvos.
it: Sono usciti. Non sono tornati interi.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: They will not let us print it.
fr: Ils ne nous laisseraient pas le publier.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Though I do not know the difference.
fr: Même si je ne sais pas en quoi cela diffère.
it: Anche se non conosco la differenza.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Three days the Brothers spent ordering those, Nephilim.
fr: Les frères ont passé trois jours à classer tout ça, Nephilim.
es: Los Hermanos pasaron tres días ordenando a esos, Nefilim.
it: I fratelli hanno impiegato tre giorni per ordinarli, Nefilim.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: قضى الإخوة ثلاثة أيام في ترتيب كل هذا، يا نيفيليم.

source_en: Three days. Three days of sorting.
fr: Trois jours. Trois jours passés à trier.
es: Tres días. Tres días de clasificación.
it: Tre giorni. Tre giorni di smistamento.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ثلاثة أيام. ثلاثة أيام من الفرز.

source_en: Three days. Three days of sorting. The fourth day I was to rest.
fr: Three days. Three days of sorting. The fourth day I was to rest.
es: Three days. Three days of sorting. The fourth day I was to rest.
it: Three days. Three days of sorting. The fourth day I was to rest.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ثلاثة أيام. ثلاثة أيام من الفرز. وفي اليوم الرابع كان عليّ أن أرتاح.

speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ثلاث عقائد للحفاظ عليها: في القمر،

source_en: Three faiths to keep: in the moon, the order, and the dead.
fr: Three faiths to keep: in the moon, the order, and the dead.
es: Three faiths to keep: in the moon, the order, and the dead.
it: Three faiths to keep: in the moon, the order, and the dead.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ثلاث عقائد للحفاظ عليها: في القمر، وفي الجماعة، وفي الموتى.

source_en: Three weeks of sorting. Walk on.
fr: Trois semaines de tri. On continue.
es: Tres semanas de clasificación. Sigue adelante.
it: Tre settimane di smistamento. Vai avanti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: ثلاثة أسابيع من الفرز. واصل المسير.

fr: Ils étaient trois à former le mur.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Three were the wall. I had not understood, until tonight, that they were the wall.
fr: Three were the wall. I had not understood, until tonight, that they were the wall.
es: Three were the wall. I had not understood, until tonight, that they were the wall.
it: Three were the wall. I had not understood, until tonight, that they were the wall.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: كانوا الثلاثة هم الجدار. لم أدرك، حتى الليلة، أنهم كانوا الجدار.

source_en: Touch the doorframe before you cross it.
fr: Touche le cadre de la porte avant de la franchir.
es: Toca el marco de la puerta antes de cruzarla.
it: Prima di varcare la soglia, tocca lo stipite della porta.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: المس إطار الباب قبل أن تعبره.

source_en: Touch the doorframe before you cross it. Lunarin does not enter rooms he was not invited to.
fr: Touch the doorframe before you cross it. Lunarin does not enter rooms he was not invited to.
es: Touch the doorframe before you cross it. Lunarin does not enter rooms he was not invited to.
it: Touch the doorframe before you cross it. Lunarin does not enter rooms he was not invited to.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: المس إطار الباب قبل أن تعبره. لوناران لا يدخل غرفاً لم يُدعَ إليها.

source_en: Two of the dead are gone now.
fr: Deux des morts ne sont plus parmi nous.
es: Dos de los fallecidos ya no están.
it: Due dei morti non ci sono più.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: Two of the dead are gone now. There were three. There is one.
fr: Two of the dead are gone now. There were three. There is one.
es: Two of the dead are gone now. There were three. There is one.
it: Two of the dead are gone now. There were three. There is one.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: اثنان من الموتى رحلا الآن. كان هناك ثلاثة. بقي واحد.

source_en: Two who do not pray conspiring together.
fr: Deux personnes qui ne prient pas et qui complotent ensemble.
es: Dos que no oran conspirando juntos.
it: Due che non pregano cospirano insieme.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

es: Valahk-Nor asustó a los niños una vez.
it: Valahk-Nor una volta spaventava i bambini.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أثار ڤالاك-نور رعب الأطفال ذات مرة.

source_en: Valahk-Nor frightened children once. He frightens none tonight.
fr: Valahk-Nor frightened children once. He frightens none tonight.
es: Valahk-Nor frightened children once. He frightens none tonight.
it: Valahk-Nor frightened children once. He frightens none tonight.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أثار ڤالاك-نور رعب الأطفال ذات مرة. هو لا يرهب أحدا الليلة.

source_en: We are encouraged not to speak of him.
fr: On nous recommande de ne pas parler de lui.
es: Se nos recomienda no hablar de él.
it: Ci viene raccomandato di non parlare di lui.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: We are told he stopped biting. We are told.
fr: On nous a dit qu'il avait arrêté de mordre. On nous l’a dit.
es: Nos dicen que ya no muerde. Eso nos dicen.
it: Ci è stato detto che ha smesso di mordere.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: قيل لنا إنه كف عن العض. قيل لنا.

source_en: We are told this is metaphor.
fr: On nous dit qu'il s'agit d'une métaphore.
es: Se nos dice que esto es metáfora.
it: Ci viene detto che si tratta di una metafora.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: We are told this is metaphor.
fr: On nous dit qu'il s'agit d'une métaphore.
es: Se nos dice que esto es metáfora.
it: Ci viene detto che si tratta di una metafora.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: We do not look at the moon directly.
fr: Nous ne regardons pas la lune directement.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نحن لا ننظر إلى القمر مباشرة.

source_en: We do not look at the moon directly. We look at its reflection in the basin. The basin's reflection is older.
fr: We do not look at the moon directly. We look at its reflection in the basin. The basin's reflection is older.
es: We do not look at the moon directly. We look at its reflection in the basin. The basin's reflection is older.
it: We do not look at the moon directly. We look at its reflection in the basin. The basin's reflection is older.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نحن لا ننظر إلى القمر مباشرة. نحن ننظر إلى انعكاسه في الحوض. انعكاس الحوض أقدم.

source_en: We do not speak of the Apostate Hunts.
fr: Nous ne parlons pas des chasses aux apostats.
es: No hablamos de las cacerías de los Apostatas.
it: Noi non parliamo delle cacce agli apostati.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نحن لا نتحدث عن صيد المرتدين.

source_en: We have been taught the difference.
fr: On nous a appris la différence.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: We have noticed, Nephilim, that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
fr: We have noticed, Nephilim, that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
es: We have noticed, Nephilim, that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
it: We have noticed, Nephilim, that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لقد لاحظنا، أيها النيفيليم، أن التاجر يكون أكثر سعادةً في الأيام التي تزوره فيها.

source_en: We look at its reflection in the basin.
fr: Nous regardons son reflet dans le bassin.
es: Miramos su reflejo en la pileta.
it: Osserviamo il suo riflesso nel bacino.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نحن ننظر إلى انعكاسه في الحوض.

fr: Nous avons prié pour la libération d'E'frae.
es: Oramos por la liberación de E'frae.
it: Abbiamo pregato per la liberazione di E'frae.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: We prayed for E'frae's release. I am told... that is what we did. I am told.
fr: We prayed for E'frae's release. I am told... that is what we did. I am told.
es: We prayed for E'frae's release. I am told... that is what we did. I am told.
it: We prayed for E'frae's release. I am told... that is what we did. I am told.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: صلينا من أجلِ تحريرِ إفراي. قيلَ لي… هذا ما فعلناه. قيلَ لي.

source_en: We see the Knight visits the smith often.
fr: Nous voyons que le chevalier se rend souvent chez le forgeron.
es: Vemos que el Caballero visita al herrero a menudo.
it: Vediamo che il cavaliere fa spesso visita al fabbro.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نرى أن الفارس يزور الحداد كثيرا.

source_en: We see the Knight visits the smith often. The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
fr: We see the Knight visits the smith often. The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
es: We see the Knight visits the smith often. The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
it: We see the Knight visits the smith often. The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نرى أن الفارس يزور الحداد كثيرا. الحداد بارع في عمله. بالنسبة لذئب.

source_en: We who scorn the Dragon's Light embrace the Holy Moonlight.
fr: Nous qui méprisons la lumière du dragon, nous embrassons le clair de lune sacré.
es: Nosotros, que despreciamos la Luz del Dragón, abrazamos la Sagrada Luz de la Luna.
it: Noi che disprezziamo la luce del Drago abbracciamo la sacra luce della luna.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: نحن الذين نحتقر ضوء التنين، نعانق ضوء القمر المقدس.

source_en: We've many Nephilim and shan't dare breed anymore.
fr: Nous avons déjà beaucoup de Nephilims. Nous n’en engendrerons pas d'autres.
es: Tenemos muchos Nefilim y no nos atreveremos a criar más.
it: Abbiamo molti Nefilim e non oseremo crearne altri.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لدينا الكثير من النيفيليم، ولن نجرؤ على إنجاب المزيد.

source_en: When Cardinal Mathias was put down,
fr: Lorsque le cardinal Mathias a été tué,
es: Cuando el cardenal Matías fue ejecutado,
it: Quando il Cardinale Mathias è stato ucciso,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: When Cardinal Mathias was put down, the altar of his chapter cracked. Not from anything that was done. Not from anything we know.
fr: When Cardinal Mathias was put down, the altar of his chapter cracked. Not from anything that was done. Not from anything we know.
es: When Cardinal Mathias was put down, the altar of his chapter cracked. Not from anything that was done. Not from anything we know.
it: When Cardinal Mathias was put down, the altar of his chapter cracked. Not from anything that was done. Not from anything we know.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: عندما أُسقط الكاردينال ماثياس، تشقق مذبح فصله. ليس بسبب فعلٍ أُتي به. ليس بسبب شيءٍ نعرفه.

source_en: When the Knight falls, some of us speak of mercy. Some of judgment. I keep my mouth where the mouth belongs.
fr: When the Knight falls, some of us speak of mercy. Some of judgment. I keep my mouth where the mouth belongs.
es: When the Knight falls, some of us speak of mercy. Some of judgment. I keep my mouth where the mouth belongs.
it: When the Knight falls, some of us speak of mercy. Some of judgment. I keep my mouth where the mouth belongs.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: حين يسقط الفارس، يتحدث بعضنا عن الرحمة. ويتحدث آخرون عن الحساب. وأنا أبقي فمي حيث ينبغي أن يكون الفم.

source_en: When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor.
fr: Lorsque le Nephilim passe, n’essaie pas de le regarde dans les yeux.
es: Cuando pase el Nefilim, no mires directamente a su visor.
it: Quando il Nefilim passa, non incrociare la visiera del suo elmo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: حين يمرُّ النيفيليم، لا تتقابل عيناك مع القناع.

source_en: When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor. The visor was cut deep for a reason.
fr: When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor. The visor was cut deep for a reason.
es: When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor. The visor was cut deep for a reason.
it: When the Nephilim passes, do not meet the visor. The visor was cut deep for a reason.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: حين يمرُّ النيفيليم، لا تتقابل عيناك مع القناع. لقد نُحت القناع بعمق لسببٍ ما.

source_en: When the moon is red, the prayers must be louder. So we are taught.
fr: When the moon is red, the prayers must be louder. So we are taught.
es: When the moon is red, the prayers must be louder. So we are taught.
it: When the moon is red, the prayers must be louder. So we are taught.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: عندما يكون القمر أحمر، يجب أن تكون الصلوات أعلى صوتا. هكذا تعلمنا.

source_en: You are weapons for the faith. Nothing more.
fr: Vous êtes des armes pour la foi. Rien de plus.
es: Son armas de la fe. Nada más.
it: Siete armi per la fede. Niente di più.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أنتَ أسلحةٌ للإيمان. لا شيءَ أكثر من ذلك.

source_en: You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim.
fr: Tu passes de longues heures avec la bibliothécaire, Nephilim.
es: Pasas muchas horas con la Bibliotecaria, Nefilim.
it: Trascorri lunghe ore con la bibliotecaria, Nefilim.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تقضي ساعاتٍ طوالاً مع أمينة المكتبة،

source_en: You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim. I would ask what she has you reading, but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
fr: You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim. I would ask what she has you reading, but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
es: You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim. I would ask what she has you reading, but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
it: You spend long hours with the Librarian, Nephilim. I would ask what she has you reading, but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تقضي ساعاتٍ طوالاً مع أمينة المكتبة، يا نيفيليم. كنتُ لأسألك عما تجعلك تقرأه، لكنك لن تخبرني، وهي ستخبرني أقل من ذلك.

source_en: You will, of course, help me put those back.
fr: Tu vas bien sûr m'aider à les remettre à leur place.
es: Por supuesto, me vas a ayudar a devolverlos.
it: Naturalmente, mi aiuterai a rimetterli a posto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: سوف تساعدني، بطبيعة الحال، في إعادتهم إلى مكانهم.

source_en: and I am running out of comfortable answers.
fr: et je serai bientôt à court de réponses satisfaisantes.
es: y me estoy quedando sin respuestas cómodas.
it: e sto per finire le risposte educate.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: and another that ought to worry you.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: and the State is the Faith.
es: y el Estado es la Fe.
it: e lo Stato è la fede.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: and the fact is becoming difficult to ignore.
fr: et cela devient difficile à ignorer.
es: y el hecho se está volviendo difícil de ignorar.
it: e questo fatto sta diventando difficile da ignorare.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: and you have been visiting often enough now
fr: et tu es allé le voir si souvent
es: y ya has ido con tanta frecuencia
it: e ormai gli hai fatto visita abbastanza spesso
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: lors de la prière du soir la semaine dernière.
es: en la oración de la tarde la semana pasada.
it: durante la preghiera serale della scorsa settimana.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: but you would not tell me, and she would tell me less.
fr: mais tu ne me le dirais pas, et elle encore moins.
es: pero no me lo dirías, y ella mucho menos.
it: ma non me lo diresti, né tantomeno lo farebbe lei.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لكنك لن تخبرني، وهي ستخبرني أقل من ذلك.

source_en: by all the proper measures, a great man.
fr: à tous égards, un grand homme.
es: según todos los criterios pertinentes, un gran hombre.
it: sotto ogni punto di vista, un grande uomo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: تؤمن العقيدة بأن الطقس مخصص للمحتضرين.

source_en: commanding Legions of Angels in service of man's potential.
fr: commandant des légions d’anges au service du potentiel de l’homme.
es: comandando Legiones de Ángeles al servicio del potencial del hombre.
it: al comando di legioni di angeli al servizio del potenziale umano,
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: يقود فيالق الملائكة في خدمة إمكانات البشر.

source_en: expected there would be a dragon.
fr: imaginé qu’il y aurait un dragon.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: for one hundred and twenty-six years.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: in the last days of the Crusade.
fr: pendant les derniers jours de la croisade.
es: en los últimos días de la Cruzada.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: in the moon, the order, and the dead.
fr: la lune, l'Ordre et les morts.
es: en la luna, la orden y los muertos.
it: nella luna, nell'Ordine e nei morti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: mustn't stop until the demons are finished.
fr: il ne faut pas s'arrêter tant que les démons ne sont pas vaincus.
es: no debemos parar hasta que los demonios hayan sido eliminados.
it: non dobbiamo fermarci finché i demoni non saranno sconfitti.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: لا يجوز التوقف حتى يتم القضاء على الشياطين.

source_en: once for the thing that watches the hunger.
fr: une fois pour la chose qui veille sur la faim.
es: una vez por la cosa que vigila el hambre.
it: una volta per la cosa che osserva la fame.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: one could see across a hall.
fr: depuis l'autre bout de la pièce.
es: desde el otro lado del pasillo.
it: che si potesse vedere dall'altra parte della stanza.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: some of us speak of mercy.
fr: certains d'entre nous parlent de miséricorde.
es: algunos de nosotros hablamos de misericordia.
it: alcuni di noi parlano di misericordia.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: quelque part dans les chambres inférieures.
es: en algún lugar de las cámaras inferiores.
it: da qualche parte nelle camere inferiori.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: في مكان ما في الغرف السفلية.

source_en: that I suspect you have begun to understand this.
fr: que je soupçonne que tu commences à t’en rendre compte.
es: que sospecho que ya te has dado cuenta de esto.
it: che sospetto che tu abbia cominciato a capire.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: وقد زرتَه مرات كافية حتى أظن أنك بدأت تفهم ذلك.

source_en: that all stacked things are eventually unstacked.
fr: que tout ce qui est empilé finit par ne plus l’être.
es: que todo lo que está apilado acaba por desapilarse.
it: tutte le cose impilate a un certo punto non lo saranno più.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أن كل ما يُكدّس سيتفكك في نهاية المطاف.

source_en: that is not the guile sun.
fr: qui n’est pas le soleil trompeur.
es: que no es el sol engañoso.
it: quello non è il sole astuto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

fr: que c'est ce que nous avons fait.
es: que eso es lo que hicimos.
it: che è ciò che abbiamo fatto.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
fr: que le marchand est plus heureux les jours où tu lui rends visite.
es: que el Comerciante está más contento los días que lo visitas.
it: che il mercante è più contento nei giorni in cui vai a trovarlo.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: أن التاجر يكون أكثر سعادةً في الأيام التي تزوره فيها.

source_en: the Faith holds, if one is keeping them safely.
fr: des livres hérétiques, tant qu’elle les garde en lieu sûr.
es: siempre y cuando los mantenga a salvo.
it: La Fede regge, se li si custodiscono con cura.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1
ar: إذا كان المرء يحتفظ بها بأمان.

source_en: the Faith would have informed me.
es: la Fe me lo habría informado.
speaker: NPC_Hub_Monk_1

source_en: the altar of his chapter cracked.
fr: l'autel de son chapitre s'est fissuré.
es: el altar de su capítulo se agrietó.

speaker: NPC_Librarian

speaker: NPC_Librarian
ar: عضة مصاص دماء. أتساءل إن كانت رومانسية كما تصفها الكتب.

source_en: A way to stop the madness...
fr: Un moyen de mettre fin à cette folie...
es: Una forma de detener la locura...
it: Un modo per fermare la follia...
speaker: NPC_Librarian

es: Después de la Cruzada de Caín
